turns.question: What were our sales on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: "Sales" can mean gross revenue or net revenue, so both figures for 1 October 2026 (one day): revenue (non-cancelled orders, gross) was 981.69 EUR, and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: I mean net sales, after returns.
turns.answer: Net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) for 1 October 2026, one day, was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
